fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-07-07 at roughly 14:45, it was reported that a caller claiming to be a bank executive asked the complainant to install a support application, after which Rs. 32,000 was withdrawn. The complainant, Praveen Kumar, provided the contact number 9000000122. Thirumal Palanisamy (mobile 9000000135) was named as a possible person of interest. Madhan Kumar (9000000410) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100026. The complaint refers to Mathan Raman, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000187. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a call detail reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00006, as the mobile number 9000000135 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly posed as a bank executive and asked for remote access.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, call detail, suspect, associate, mobile number, afternoon, witness
